name: Speedster
description: iPhone/CarPlay app with a map of speed cameras, early radar alerts, speed-limit warnings, and turn-by-turn directions on the car's instrument cluster/HUD (company-stated, App Store). Tagline "Fine trips without fines". Free with in-app purchases. Developer Kirill Konovalov (App Store). 4.2★ from 44 ratings on the App Store page fetched today. Founded May 2020. 2,451 active subscriptions; L30 profit margin 70%. speedster.app is a video-only splash page with no og:image.

No cliff. Revenue synced 19 October 2026 ~07:10 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: CarPlay/Android Auto utilities for one local pain: Polish paid-parking zones (SPP) and odcinkowy pomiar prędkości (average-speed sections), toll-road e-TOLL reminders, or truck-legal routing. Sell it as a fines-avoided subscription.

whyItPrints: Avoiding speeding fines is a habit purchase. Drivers keep the subscription for years, and the camera database is the moat. Very flat ~$6–8k every month for a year, and almost $300k lifetime from one utility app.
